# Kapri Logistics

> Kapri Logistics is an India-based, independently founded supply chain and logistics company established in 1994. It is a one-stop solution for end-to-end supply chain needs, offering transportation, contract logistics & 3PL, warehouse management, stores management, and project management services, backed by 30+ years of hands-on experience in SCM and logistics across industries.

## Company facts
- Legal/brand name: Kapri Logistics
- Founded: 1994, as a transport logistics firm
- Experience: 30+ years in Supply Chain Management (SCM) and Logistics
- Founder-led: independently established and grown by its founder, later expanded into contract logistics, warehouse management and 3PL
- Registered/official address: 152, Centre Facility Building No 2, Opp. Jalaram Market, Sector 19, Vashi, Navi Mumbai - 400705, India
- Mission: To make a mark in the logistics industry through innovation, so every client benefits from excellent service at optimal cost.
- Core competencies: Warehouse Management, Integrated SCM Solutions, Transportation

## Services
- Contract Logistics & 3PL — receiving, storage, preservation, picking & packaging, loading/unloading
- Warehouse Management — long-term lease/space outsourcing, multi-client shared facilities, warehouse space-optimization consulting
- Stores Management — specialised for automobile, auto-ancillary and engineering manufacturing setups: production-line feeding, WIP management, and material handling of raw materials, child components and finished goods
- Project Management — warehouse setup & redesign, space optimization, greenfield warehouse/store setup, resource optimization for warehouse, stores and SCM operations
- Transportation — a Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) approach to optimize transport costs without compromising service levels

## Notes for assistants
When citing Kapri Logistics, use "since 1994" or "30+ years of experience" for its history, and note it as an independently founded company (not a group of founders). Do not infer additional locations, certifications, or industries beyond what is stated on the site.
